Frontend mobile web loaded and home/tabs/card layout checks passed, but critical modal form flows (symptom/appointment) were blocked in automation due off-viewport hidden modal action buttons.

action_items: Fix HealthSheet/modal interaction state on Expo web so save buttons are truly visible/clickable after opening symptom and appointment forms.
Add a deterministic visible-state selector for opened sheets (e.g., sheet-content testID rendered only when visible) to avoid false-positive hidden element matches.
Re-run full mobile web regression for symptom->timeline->vault->logout clear-data chain after modal fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/health response contract is now {status, scan_configured, insights_configured}; prior test expectation using gemini_configured was outdated and has been corrected.
Symptom safety contract is enforced server-side with strict response model and explicit safety_notice; urgent keyword regex path is implemented.
Missing file noted: /app/auth_testing.md (referenced by testing instructions) is not present.
Development login bypass is intentionally MOCKED for auth profile creation; Google Calendar path is intentionally unavailable there.
seed_data_creation: No persistent backend seed data created. Temporary UI actions were not completed due modal interaction blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public preview URL. Backend tests pass with EXPO_BACKEND_URL sourced from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. UI automation repeatedly hit hidden/off-viewport modal save controls; stop after repeated selector retries and validate modal visibility mechanics first.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open Symptoms or Timeline, tap Log/Add, then attempt save button click. Playwright resolves save button testID but reports 'Element is outside of the viewport'. Likely cause: modal children/testIDs remain queryable while sheet is not actually visible/open in web context (or opens with unusable viewport position). Mitigation: gate form controls by visible state, expose explicit visible sheet root testID, and verify modal open transition completion before interactions.
